task.title: Partial write-off approved — Previously established Overpayment (OP)

step.cmd: In PSCD, determine if the financial and non-financial adjustments are available:
In PSCD, determine if the debt was originally established:

ul.li:
If no, determine if an outstanding balance was converted to PSCD:
If yes, go to step 20.
If no, the debt no longer has an active balance. Go to step 26.

step.cmd: Adjust the initial OP by the amount that was written off. Refer to Adjusting a debt in PSCD and go to step 21.
Create a debt transaction for the amount to be written off. Refer to Creating a debt in PSCD , and go to step 26.
In FTS, determine if there is an outstanding registration number for the write-off issue:

ul.li:
If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised Decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim on which the OP occurred.
Earnings to be allocated: Leave the field blank.
Remarks line 2: Type “Amend [code for the decision to be amended (e.g. D1)] [XXXX-XXXX], enter the decision information for the period that will be written off (e.g. D1 2398-1 to 2407-5 31B 66 ).”
Remarks line 3: Enter the decision information for the period that cannot be written off (e.g. D1 2408-1 to 9999 31B 04 ).
Remarks line 4: Enter any additional information if necessary or leave the field blank.
Remarks line 5: Type your first name and your last name.

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To complete the registration number, select C - Yes .
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if there is an AI WI for the write-off issue:

ul.li: If no, no further action is required.
